1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based electronic control unit arranged to receive input signals and execute control algorithms to modulate valve operation__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __at least two__ plural first valves and/or plural second valves.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise __at least two__ one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and __at least two__ one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough.

4. (Original) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein __each of__ one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators __and the control means is arranged to modulate the duty cycle of the binary actuators to achieve proportional control of air pressure in the brake chamber__.

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, __and wherein the control means is further arranged to process said signals using stored calibration data and control algorithms__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, __and wherein the control means is arranged to dynamically adjust the reference data based on real-time sensor feedback__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein the control means continuously updates the optimum speed calculation at a frequency of at least 10 Hz__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, __wherein the pump is controlled by the control means of the air braking unit to maintain a predetermined pressure range in the storage tank__.
